Module com.example.sudoku_game
Package com.example.sudoku_game.controller

Class EndController

java.lang.Object
com.example.sudoku_game.controller.EndController
public class EndController extends Object
Controller for the end screen of the Sudoku application. This class handles the final screen displayed after a game session ends. It shows the player's results including time, mistakes, and hints used, and provides options to play again or quit the application. This controller is linked to the EndView.fxml layout file and receives game result data from GameController via the setData(java.lang.String, int, int, boolean) method.

  • Method Details

    • setData

      public void setData(String time, int mistakes, int helps, boolean won)
      Populates the end screen with the game result data and starts the finish music. Sets the time, mistake count, and hint count labels with the provided values. If the player won, the win label is updated with a success message and styled in green. The finish music track is started after the data is applied.
      Parameters:
      time - the elapsed game time in MM:SS format.
      mistakes - the total number of mistakes made during the game.
      helps - the total number of hints used during the game.
      won - whether the player completed the board successfully.
